title: Screen grid system and sensitive content mitigation workflow for global release assets
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Goal: Define and deliver a reproducible screen-grid and export workflow that produces brand-aligned, localization-safe product screenshots for docs, quickstarts, and release marketing. The workflow must: 1) apply a consistent 8pt-based responsive grid across breakpoints, 2) detect and mask sensitive UI elements automatically (PII, email/phone numbers, account IDs) with editable overlay presets, 3) generate region-specific crops that preserve call-to-action positions and allow room for RTL languages, and 4) produce named export bundles (PNG/SVG/WEBP) with metadata for automated publishing. This ticket scopes the design system additions, masking heuristics spec, export presets, and validation checklist for handoff to engineering and content teams. Consider trade-offs between aggressive automatic redaction (higher false positives) and manual QA effort. Work should be compatible with existing Figma tokens and the Console style kit.
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens extended with grid breakpoints and snapshot frame presets documented in Figma
Automated masking spec with three overlay styles (blur, solid, skeleton) and priority rules documented
Localization crop rules for LTR and RTL that preserve CTAs across English, German, Japanese, and Arabic
Export presets defined: full-width 1440x900, hero 1200x600, mobile 375x812; bundled with descriptive filenames and metadata JSON
QA checklist and sample dataset (20+ screenshots across regions) validated and signed off by PM and Eng lead
deliverables: Figma file: Screen grid components and preset frames
Confluence doc: Masking heuristics and overlay styles
Export spec: presets, naming conventions, metadata fields
Design tokens PR for style kit repository
Validation dataset: 24 localized screenshots with notes
decisions: Default masking style will be 'skeleton' (neutral gray blocks) to avoid leaking structure-sensitive content
Grid uses 8pt base with breakpoints: 360, 768, 1024, 1440; components align to 4-col/8-col variants
CTAs are anchored by safe-area rules leaving minimum 24px breathing room on crops
Automated redaction will run in two phases: heuristic detection then human review for any flagged low-confidence items
risks: False positives from OCR heuristics could obscure UI elements that convey product value
RTL crops may require manual tweaks for languages with long script expansion (e.g., German vs Arabic)
Engineering bandwidth for integrating automatic masking into the asset pipeline is limited during the release window
tasks: Design: create frame presets and responsive layout examples in Figma
Design: write masking heuristics doc with examples and confidence thresholds
PM: coordinate sample dataset from Growth + Support teams to cover edge cases
Eng: review export metadata schema and estimate integration effort
QA: run validation checklist against sample dataset and record adjustments
